title: 中国银行电子银行个人服务转账汇款费率表 (personal transfer tariff)
verbatim: 跨境汇款（电汇） 每笔汇款金额的1‰，最低收取50元/笔，最高收取260元/笔；另收电讯费,港澳台地区人民币80元/笔,非港澳台地区人民币150元/笔。 收费标准2014年11月1日起。备注1：另有协议约定、价格优惠、地方性收费差异的，按照协议或当地公示的内容收取相关费用。

title: 2024年经常项目外汇政策问答案例（九）, 2024-06-21
verbatim: 根据《国家外汇管理局关于印发〈经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）〉的通知》（汇发〔2020〕14号）第五十九条，境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇。持有外国人永久居留身份证的境外个人适用购汇年度便利化额度。
what_it_settles: A foreign individual converts lawful current-account RMB income with ID plus source-of-funds documents including tax evidence (art 59); only Foreign Permanent Resident ID holders get the annual convenience amount.

title: 2022年外汇业务政策释疑（八）, 2022-09-29
verbatim: 目前，我国对于真实、合法的经常项目和已开放的资本项目下购汇和结汇都没有金额限制 … 年度便利化额度不是个人每年购汇或者结汇的限额，只是超过等值5万美元的购汇或结汇不能仅凭本人有效身份证件办理 … 第五十六条 境内个人凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的结汇资金来源材料 … 第五十七条 境内个人凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金用途材料
what_it_settles: There is no USD 50,000 cap: the convenience amount is an annual facility, and above it the bank needs source-of-funds (sale) or purpose (purchase) documents.

title: 2026年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（08）, 2026-07-13
verbatim: 境外个人在境内工作期间取得的劳动报酬如何购汇汇出？答：… 第五十九条规定，"境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇"。
what_it_settles: Confirms art 59 applies to salary earned in China; same 2026 reading as the 2024 answer.

title: 2025年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（八）, 2025-06-13
verbatim: 第六十二条规定，外汇局对借用他人便利化额度及其他方式规避便利化额度及真实性管理的个人，列入"关注名单"管理。"关注名单"内个人的关注期限为列入"关注名单"的当年及之后连续2年。
what_it_settles: Using other people's convenience amounts puts you on a watchlist for the rest of that year and the next two.

title: 2026年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（10）, 2026-09-17
verbatim: 第六十条规定，境外个人原兑换未用完的人民币兑回外汇，凭本人有效身份证件和原兑换水单办理，原兑换水单的兑回有效期为自兑换日起24个月；对于当日累计兑换不超过等值500美元（含）以及离境前在境内关外场所当日累计不超过等值1000美元（含）的兑换，可凭本人有效身份证件办理。
what_it_settles: Unused RMB can be changed back on the original exchange slip for 24 months; small amounts (USD 500 a day) on ID alone.

title: 2021年服务贸易外汇管理问题解答（四）, 2021-11-02
verbatim: 境外个人将其从境内取得的服务贸易、收益和经常转移项下的人民币收入购汇汇出的，可凭境外个人本人身份证件和有交易额的相关证明材料（含税务凭证）办理，其中，税务凭证包括由税务部门出具的《服务贸易等项目对外支付税务备案表》（含电子备案信息）或完税证明或免税证明等材料。
what_it_settles: Names the three documents that count as the tax evidence the bank wants.

title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 (国务院令第532号)
verbatim: 第五条 国家对经常性国际支付和转移不予限制。第十二条 经常项目外汇收支应当具有真实、合法的交易基础 … 对交易单证的真实性及其与外汇收支的一致性进行合理审查。第三十九条 逃汇 … 处逃汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款。第四十二条 违反规定携带外汇出入境的 … 可以处违法金额20%以下的罚款。第四十五条 私自买卖外汇、变相买卖外汇 … 处违法金额30%以下的罚款。第五十二条 境内个人，是指中国公民和在中华人民共和国境内连续居住满1年的外国人。
what_it_settles: The statute: current payments are not restricted but must be genuine; the fines (30 % for evasion and for private FX trading, 20 % for cash); and who counts as a domestic individual.

title: 中国人民银行公告[2004]第16号 — 个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法
verbatim: 第六条 移民转移必须一次性申请拟转移出境的全部财产金额，分步汇出。首次可汇出金额不得超过全部申请转移财产的一半；自首次汇出满一年后，可汇出不超过剩余财产的一半；自首次汇出满两年后，可汇出全部剩余财产。全部申请转移财产在等值人民币20万元以下（含20万元）的，经批准后可一次性汇出。第十条 申请财产对外转移总金额在等值人民币50万元以下（含50万元）的，由所在地外汇局审批 … 超过上述金额的 … 报国家外汇管理局审批。第十一条 外汇指定银行办理售汇后，应直接将外汇汇往移民或继承人居住国或地区申请人本人的账户，不得在境内提取外币现钞。第十二条 … 不能证明合法来源财产等的对外转移申请，外汇局不予受理。
what_it_settles: How emigrant and inheritance transfers work: staged payouts, approval thresholds, mandatory direct wire to your own account, and refusal where the source cannot be proved.

title: 国家外汇管理局关于规范银行卡境外大额提取现金交易的通知 (汇发〔2017〕29号)
verbatim: 个人持境内银行卡在境外提取现金，本人名下银行卡（含附属卡）合计每个自然年度不得超过等值10万元人民币。超过年度额度的，本年及次年将被暂停持境内银行卡在境外提取现金 … 外币卡由每卡每日不得超过等值1000美元调整为等值1万元人民币 … 人民币卡管理维持每卡每日不得超过等值1万元人民币。
what_it_settles: The card route is capped at RMB 100,000 a calendar year across all your cards, and RMB 10,000 a card a day.

title: 外汇知识问答：请问每次可带外币出境的限额是多少？ 2019-05-21
verbatim: 个人携带外币现钞金额在5000美元（含）以下的，海关直接放行；5000美元以上10000美元（含）以下的，应向银行申领《携带外汇出境许可证》；10000美元以上的，应向外汇局申领《携带外汇出境许可证》但原则上 … 不得携带10000美元以上的外币现钞出境。
what_it_settles: Cash carried out: up to USD 5,000 free, USD 5,000-10,000 with a bank permit, above USD 10,000 needs a SAFE permit and is in principle not allowed.

title: 中华人民共和国个人所得税法 (2018 amendment)
verbatim: 第三条 … 综合所得，适用百分之三至百分之四十五的超额累进税率 … 利息、股息、红利所得，财产租赁所得，财产转让所得和偶然所得，适用比例税率，税率为百分之二十。第十三条 … 纳税人因移居境外注销中国户籍的，应当在注销中国户籍前办理税款清算。第十五条 … 个人转让不动产的，税务机关应当根据不动产登记等相关信息核验应缴的个人所得税，登记机构办理转移登记时，应当查验与该不动产转让相关的个人所得税的完税凭证。
what_it_settles: Chinese income tax rates on the money behind the balance, and the tax settlement required before cancelling a Chinese hukou for emigration.

title: 财税〔2008〕132号 关于储蓄存款利息所得有关个人所得税政策的通知
verbatim: 自2008年10月9日起，对储蓄存款利息所得暂免征收个人所得税 … 储蓄存款在2008年10月9日后（含10月9日）孳生的利息所得，暂免征收个人所得税。
what_it_settles: Bank deposit interest is exempt from Chinese individual income tax from 2008-10-09.

title: 关于进一步防范和处置虚拟货币等相关风险的通知 (银发〔2026〕42号), 2026-02-06
verbatim: 虚拟货币相关业务活动属于非法金融活动。在境内开展法定货币与虚拟货币兑换业务 … 一律严格禁止，坚决依法取缔 … 金融机构（含非银行支付机构）不得为虚拟货币相关业务活动提供账户开立、资金划转和清算结算等服务 … 本通知自发布之日起施行。中国人民银行等十部门《关于进一步防范和处置虚拟货币交易炒作风险的通知》（银发〔2021〕237号）同时废止。
what_it_settles: RMB-to-crypto is a prohibited route, and the 2021 notice that older pages cite has been repealed by this one.

title: 26 U.S.C. § 988 — Treatment of certain foreign currency transactions
verbatim: (a)(1)(A) any foreign currency gain or loss attributable to a section 988 transaction shall be computed separately and treated as ordinary income or loss … (c)(1)(C)(i) In the case of any disposition of any nonfunctional currency — (I) such disposition shall be treated as a section 988 transaction … (e)(2) … no gain shall be recognized … if … the transaction is a personal transaction. The preceding sentence shall not apply if the gain which would otherwise be recognized on the transaction exceeds $200. (e)(3) 'personal transaction' … shall not include any transaction to the extent that expenses properly allocable to such transaction meet the requirements of (A) section 162 (other than traveling expenses) or (B) section 212 (other than … taxes).
what_it_settles: Selling RMB is a §988 disposition taxed as ordinary income, with a personal-transaction exception that stops applying once the gain exceeds USD 200.

title: Comparison of Form 8938 and FBAR requirements
verbatim: Reporting threshold: Specified individuals living in the US … more than $50,000 on the last day of the tax year, or more than $75,000 at any time during the year … living outside the US … more than $200,000 … or more than $300,000 … Penalties: Up to $10,000 for failure to disclose and an additional $10,000 for each 30 days of non-filing after IRS notice … maximum penalty of $60,000 … FBAR … Aggregate value of financial accounts exceeds $10,000 at any time during the calendar year.
what_it_settles: Both account-reporting duties, their thresholds, and the Form 8938 penalty ladder.

title: Gifts from foreign person
verbatim: For gifts or bequests from a nonresident alien or foreign estate, you are required to report … only if the aggregate amount received … exceeds $100,000 during the taxable year … For purported gifts from foreign corporations or foreign partnerships … exceeds $20,116 for 2025, and $20,573 for 2026 … you may be subject to penalties under IRC section 6039F(c) if you do not have reasonable cause.
what_it_settles: When a gift from abroad must be reported on Form 3520 Part IV, and the annual thresholds.

title: 26 U.S.C. § 6039F — Notice of large gifts received from foreign persons
verbatim: (a) … exceeds $10,000, such United States person shall furnish … such information as the Secretary may prescribe … (c)(1)(B) … an amount equal to 5 percent of the amount of such foreign gift for each month for which the failure continues (not to exceed 25 percent of such amount in the aggregate) … (c)(2) reasonable cause exception.
what_it_settles: The statutory penalty for not reporting a foreign gift: 5 % a month, capped at 25 %, with a reasonable-cause defence.

title: Money and Other Monetary Instruments
verbatim: Federal law mandates that when entering or leaving the United States you must report amounts exceeding $10,000 to U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) … When families or groups are involved, the $10,000 threshold applies to the total amount they are carrying or sending collectively, not per individual … File electronically on the FinCEN Form 105 Website … risk having their currency or monetary instruments forfeited and seized.
what_it_settles: Carrying the cash into the U.S. needs a FinCEN 105 report above USD 10,000, counted per group not per person.
